use: The Palmyrene cataphracts' horse in Chapter IX, mesh only, in a trapper of bronze scales that lies flat along the back under the game's saddle (the eastern horse's leaves a raised seat): skinned in Blender to the game's own horse skeleton (scripts/assets/bind-horse.py), as the other horses are; the code-built horse stays the stand-in. generator.prompt: An armoured horse of the Palmyrene heavy cavalry of the 270s AD, standing square for rigging: all four legs straight and vertical, evenly spaced, head raised and facing forward, tail hanging straight down, symmetrical. It wears a close-fitting armour trapper of small overlapping bronze scales sewn on leather, covering the neck, chest, flanks and hindquarters down to the belly and lying flat and smooth along the back, where a saddle will sit on top, and a plain leather bridle; the legs below the trapper are bare. Realistic proportions, anatomically accurate, worn and practical. No saddle, no saddle cloth, no rider, no face mask, no plumes, no spikes, no text or inscriptions, no modern objects, no fantasy elements.
